chain.text: **Depot Profile** 62 vehicles; 140 drivers. Certified June 2023; renewal due June 2028. Operations lead: Halvard Onstad. Night shift supervisor: Teodora Blaskovic. **Operations** 410 average daily departures; winter peak 530. Cancellations: 1.8 percent. Night shift not fully staffed. Winter peak capacity next year not modelled. **Maintenance** 8 lifts; 1100 spare parts line items. Brake check every 6000 km. February 2025 brake failure cause not established; nine vehicles grounded four days. Parts contract renegotiated November 2025; supplier contact Ingrid Solheim. **Compliance & Finance** Fuel card cloning September 2024; 4200 euros lost. Fuel card second approval above 200 euros. Route change: seven days' notice. Incident report: within 24 hours. Part above 500 euros: two quotations. **Projects & Training** Electrification study approved, unfunded. Second charging bay scheduled Q3. Old ticketing terminal on three routes. Driver training 11 days; curriculum revised April 2026. **Rostering** May 2026 roster published twice; two shifts uncovered.
